ai_language_tip: 先用正式西班牙語 usted，用歐式用詞（móvil、reserva），不要套拉丁美洲的 celular、mande 或墨西哥口語。對方改法語或葡語再跟著說；不要主動改用葡萄牙或巴西腔。
english_ok: rarely — 馬拉博、巴塔部分旅館與石油相關辦公室較可能聽懂英語；街邊餐館與公家窗口仍以西班牙語為主，法語為輔。
politeness: 開場 Buenos días / Buenas tardes 加 señor / señora 與 usted；熟識前不要改 tú。結尾 muchas gracias、que tenga buen día。
name_tip: 報名加姓即可（如 María Nse、Pedro Ondo）；當地姓名常含芳語或布比語成分，先用對方已寫在訂位裡的拼法，再逐字拼。
phone_tip: 國內號碼 9 位；市話以 3 開頭，手機目前以 2 或 5 開頭（222 123 456、555 123 456）。國際冠碼 +240，國際冠碼前綴 00。朗讀分三組，不要連念。
time_tip: 書面可用 24 小時（19:30）或「las siete y media de la tarde」。晚餐多在 20:00 前後，比西非許多城市略晚，但不要套用西班牙本土的 22:00。
number_tip: 金額用中非法郎 CFA（franco CFA / XAF），不要說 peseta 或 naira。數字用歐洲西班牙語（dieciséis，不要用墨西哥的其它習慣）。
avoid_calling: 避開 13:00–16:00 的長午休、傍晚 19:00 後打給行政與小作坊；週日許多機關與市區小店不開，不要在那時打公務電話。
closed_days: 獨立日 10 月 12 日、憲法相關假期、耶誕與新年常見公休。馬拉博與巴塔的旅館餐廳多半仍開，但市政窗口會關。
booking_channels: 幾乎都是電話加 WhatsApp；沒有可驗證的全國訂位 App。馬拉博、巴塔旅館可走官網或大型訂房網站，餐廳則直接打給店家。電信用 ORTEL 監理，營運商為當地電信（如 GETESA 體系），不要套用鄰國的 MoMo 品牌。
voice_menu: 銀行與電信熱線可能有簡短語音選單；多數餐廳、診所與市政窗口仍是人工接聽，而且線路有時不穩。
callback_habits: 店家多用 WhatsApp 回一行字或語音確認；電子郵件只見於較大旅館。不要假設會有簡訊系統。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 馬拉博、巴塔餐廳幾乎都靠電話或 WhatsApp 留桌，沒有可驗證的全國訂位平台；晚餐約 20:00，先問收不收卡還是只收現金。
usually_asked: Date and hour (almuerzo around 14:00 vs cena around 20:00)
Number of people and if a child's chair is needed
Interior with air-conditioning versus terraza
Name and a nine-digit local móvil
Cash versus card; do not assume a regional mobile-money brand

may_come_up.what: Card machines may be offline and cash in CFA is required
The dining room is inside a hotel and non-residents must be announced at the gate

sensitive_asked.what: A transfer to a personal mobile wallet is demanded before the table is written down

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 診所與醫院窗口以電話掛號或當日到場為主，沒有廣泛使用的預約 App；要問看哪一科、帶哪種證件。
usually_asked: First visit or a follow-up and the specialty
Patient name as on the documento de identidad or passport
Morning or afternoon and a callback number

may_come_up.what: Public centres may only give numbers in person in the morning
They may ask whether the patient will pay in cash

sensitive_asked.what: A full medical history is requested from a third party on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美容院與理髮店用 WhatsApp 約時間最常見，電話能通也會被轉去傳造型說明。
usually_asked: Hair, nails or barber work and a rough duration
Day and hour and a second choice if the stylist is busy
The WhatsApp number for the reminder

may_come_up.what: The stylist works from a private home and is known by a first name

sensitive_asked.what: Identity photos are demanded in a private chat before any hour is noted

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車與手機維修先打電話問有沒有人能看，再約到店；零件進口期不確定時要先說清楚。
usually_asked: What is broken and the brand if known
Leave the item at the taller versus a visit
When someone can hand it over

may_come_up.what: A part may need to be imported and the delay is unclear

sensitive_asked.what: A remote diagnosis fee is demanded to a personal account before the item is seen

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外帶直接打電話或 WhatsApp 點，馬拉博與巴塔沒有可驗證的大型外送平台；要說清取餐時間與門址。
usually_asked: Dishes and quantities
Collection time or a simple drop-off in Malabo or Bata
Name and a number that will answer at the puerta

may_come_up.what: The kitchen will only pack food within a short evening window

sensitive_asked.what: Payment is redirected to a different personal number than the restaurant's

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 商店留貨靠 WhatsApp 問存貨，較少線上目錄；電話只確認型號與何時可取。
usually_asked: The exact item and quantity
Collect in store or informal delivery in the same city
Name to put on the reserved goods

may_come_up.what: Stock may have to come from Douala or Madrid and the date is loose

sensitive_asked.what: A full transfer to a private account is required before they confirm stock

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期再打給同一間店或回原 WhatsApp，報名字與原時間即可；較大旅館才有訂單編號。
usually_asked: Original date, hour and the name
The new time or a cancellation
A new headcount if it changes

may_come_up.what: A hotel restaurant may treat a late change as a cancellation under its own rule

sensitive_asked.what: An extra payment is demanded only to change the hour

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問營業時間或收不收卡，直接打電話最準，因為許多店沒有可靠網頁。
usually_asked: The concrete question (hours, card acceptance, a dish, a spare part)
The day they plan to visit
A number if the answer will come later by WhatsApp

may_come_up.what: Staff may switch from Spanish into French mid-call

sensitive_asked.what: Someone asks the owner to read a card PIN or one-time code aloud

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 馬拉博、巴塔較大旅館可用官網或大型訂房網站，小型寄宿舍則 WhatsApp 問空房；入住仍常要出示護照。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates and how many guests
Room type and whether breakfast is included
Name as on the passport and a WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: A written confirmation may arrive only as a WhatsApp photo of the ledger

sensitive_asked.what: A passport scan and a transfer to a personal account are demanded before any confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 島嶼或大陸側的短程活動多經旅館櫃檯或導遊 WhatsApp 安排，團員少時可能取消。
usually_asked: Which outing and the date, with a weather alternative
Number of people and the meeting point (hotel or jetty)
A local móvil

may_come_up.what: A boat or vehicle leaves only if enough guests join

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to an unnamed personal wallet is required with no receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電與維修靠電話或 WhatsApp 約上門，地址要講清馬拉博或巴塔的區名與門房怎麼放行。
usually_asked: The job and a visit window
Barrio and how the technician is let in
A number that will answer at the door

may_come_up.what: The technician will quote only after seeing a photo

sensitive_asked.what: A door code and a remote prepayment are demanded before any visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫服務有限，通常打電話問當天能不能看；要說明動物種類，不要假設有線上掛號。
usually_asked: Species and the reason for the visit
Whether it can be seen the same morning
Owner name and a móvil

may_come_up.what: Animals may be seen only in the morning

sensitive_asked.what: A personal transfer is demanded to reserve a kennel with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 進口包裹常要打電話問清關或代理行，單號格式不一；不要套用國際快遞 App 的標準流程。
usually_asked: The reference and whether it is air or sea freight
Name on the consignment and a local contact
Collection in Malabo or Bata

may_come_up.what: A cash charge in CFA may be due at the agent's office

sensitive_asked.what: A wallet top-up is requested to 'release' a parcel that cannot be identified

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行與電信（經 ORTEL 監理的本地營運商）以電話為主，可能有短語音選單；不要在電話裡報密碼或一次性代碼。
usually_asked: Which bank or operator and the account or SIM
The issue in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: The caller may be asked to come to a sucursal with the identity document

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for a PIN, clave or one-time SMS code on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 馬拉博與巴塔叫車仍多靠旅館代叫、街邊的士或 WhatsApp 約司機，沒有可驗證的大規模叫車 App 覆蓋。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (hotel, aeropuerto, barrio) and the time
Passengers and bags
A number the driver can call

may_come_up.what: The hotel desk may prefer to dispatch its usual driver rather than a random taxi

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for the full fare to a personal account before sharing any plate

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房經仲介或熟人 WhatsApp 約，可能被要求先出示證件；地址用區名與地標。
usually_asked: Viewing time and rent or sale
Name and a number at the gate
Budget in CFA if asked

may_come_up.what: The agent wants to see an identity document before opening

sensitive_asked.what: A reservation fee to a personal account is demanded before any visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政與學校窗口多要本人到場，電話只能問文件與受理時間；用正式西班牙語 usted。
usually_asked: Which office or school and the purpose
The person's name as on the official document
Whether a number is issued only in person

may_come_up.what: Many counters close after the long midday break

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be from an office asks for a personal transfer to 'speed up' a file

famille Mba
